en: Black‑and‑white image showing a monumental statue of a seated man with crossed legs on a high pedestal, holding a sword. Around the base are sculpted objects such as a large dog seated alertly at the front corner and various military or travel gear (helmet, bags, rope) on the right. The monument stands on a stepped stone plinth, surrounded by an ornate metal fence with spear‑shaped finials. Tall conifer trees fill the background, and the whole scene has the look of an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.
